resources.string: Your assistant for transparent, controlled technology.
This device does not support Bluetooth LE.

NIKNOLIG needs access to nearby Bluetooth devices to scan for BLE devices and connect only after you select one. On older Android versions, BLE scanning also requires location permission. This app does not use your location.

Central assistant surface. Security approvals and device trust are never granted automatically. BLE connections are currently unauthenticated; SecurityChain P0 and device features remain pending.
